verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment saying Postmark ships an official MCP server, which would let AI agents operate the service from natural-language instructions. No first-party docs in the pack describe its tools, scope or setup, and the natural-language layer would come from the connecting AI client rather than Postmark itself. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the official MCP server and its supported operations, any native natural-language interface or assistant, hands-on or independent corroboration of the official server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
